lines.text: Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, where Moses had made God's Tent of Meeting.
David had brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to a tent he had pitched in Bethel.
Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the bronze altar, and that night God appeared to him.
Solomon asked God for strength and courage to govern the people, and he did not ask for long life.
God granted Solomon wisdom and knowledge and also promised riches, wealth and honor, and Solomon went to Jerusalem.
